scripts.surreal:docker: cd packages/app-rst && docker compose up -d nestjs-surrealdb-rest-surrealdb && docker compose logs -f nestjs-surrealdb-rest-surrealdb
scripts.surreal: surreal start --username root --password root --bind 0.0.0.0:8001 --log debug --allow-all rocksdb://database
scripts.surreal:install: mkdir -p ${HOME}/.local/bin && curl -sSfL https://download.surrealdb.com/v${SURREAL_CLI_VERSION:-3.1.6}/surreal-v${SURREAL_CLI_VERSION:-3.1.6}.linux-amd64.tgz | tar -xz -C /tmp && mv /tmp/surreal ${HOME}/.local/bin/surreal && surreal version
scripts.surreal:initdb: surreal import initdb.sql --endpoint http://localhost:${SURREALDB_PORT:-8001} --user root --pass root --ns test --db test
scripts.surreal:cli: surreal sql --endpoint ws://localhost:${SURREALDB_PORT:-8001} --namespace test --database test --auth-level root --username root --password root
scripts.surreal:export: surreal export --endpoint http://localhost:${SURREALDB_PORT:-8001} --user root --pass root --ns test --db test export.surql
